result.title: What is the goal of unsupervised machine learning?
result.summary: Unsupervised learning is one of the main branches of machine learning. Here I argue that unlike the other branches of machine learning (supervised and reinforcement learning), unsupervised learning is a rather heterogenous field that can serve several different goals. It seems futile to try to define one single goal for unsupervised learning. I identify four different goals for unsupervised learning: 1) Estimating the distribution, 2) Generating new data points, 3) Extracting features for downstream tasks, and 4) Understanding the data.

AI.brief_summary: 一篇立场性短文，主张无监督学习是异质领域，谈不上单一目标，并归纳出四类目标：估计分布、生成新数据、抽取下游特征、理解数据。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于无监督学习目标分类的概念讨论，未涉及内部推理状态、视觉证据使用、latent 生成或训练监督等具体机制；「抽取特征」虽是宽泛的表示学习目标，但与 LVR 的问题、评价或方法没有可核查的实质线索，故排除。
